Location.description: URL of the environment-group lifecycle operation to poll, of the form /environmentmanagement/environmentGroupOperations/{operationId}?api-version=1. Undocumented; verified against the live API.

x-notes: Adds a single environment (the path environmentId) to the group; there is no whole-list replace. The environment must already be a Managed Environment. The REST endpoint does not auto-upgrade it (the admin center does), and an unmanaged environment returns 400 InputValidationError.

The success response is 202 Accepted with an undocumented Location header (shown below) pointing at the group operation to poll; see [Read Operation](#/operations/environmentmanagement_getEnvironmentGroupOperation). No Operation-Location or azure-asyncoperation header is sent.

Membership is recorded on the environment record (its environmentGroupId), not as a members collection on the group. The 400 body is {error:{code:InputValidationError}}, not the documented ProblemDetails. Both api-version 1 and 2024-10-01 are accepted.

x-notes: Removes a single environment (the path environmentId) from the group; there is no whole-list replace.
Same 202 plus Location async transport as add; poll the returned Location header, see [Read Operation](#/operations/environmentmanagement_getEnvironmentGroupOperation).
Membership is validated synchronously, so removing an environment that is not currently a member returns 400 InputValidationError. A remove issued before an async add has settled will fail this way.
